lead.t: Cranial nerves: Visual field cuts, papilledema, diplopia, facial weakness — Papilledema = raised ICP; cranial nerve palsies = cavernous sinus thrombosis, HIV‑related lesions

snip.t: Cranial nerves: Visual field cuts, papilledema, diplopia, facial weakness — Papilledema = raised ICP; cranial nerve palsies = cavernous sinus thrombosis, HIV‑related lesions

Danger area of the face (upper lip and nose, the "triangle of death"): a furuncle there can cause cavernous sinus thrombosis (via the facial and ophthalmic veins), so don't squeeze it and use systemic antibiotics.
